caption: The video captures a white vertical surface holding twelve crayons standing tip-down in three loose clusters. A left group of red-brown, yellow, green and black sits beside a middle group of orange, yellow, dark blue and orange Crayola, with a right group of pink, yellow Crayola, peach and black. Colored drag streaks in red, yellow, green and black mark the surface beneath the left cluster, and orange and yellow trails run under the middle cluster. The crayons and these streaks appear to hold their positions relative to the frame throughout the segment, with no visible translation or rotation among them. A dark cup-shaped object intrudes from the top-left corner, partly out of frame at the start. Over the course of the clip this object drifts gradually rightward and downward. It increases its extent within the frame and shifts its position against the white background. The view stays continuous with no cut, and this slow movement is the most prominent change while the arranged crayons hold their places.
